name: Crust Grinder
notes: Use: classic crust and d-beat rhythm guitar. High gain, mid-dark filter, silicon clip, a little tightness so palm mutes stay clear. Pair with a plexi-style amp turned up (TONE3000 76884) and a V30-style cab (45023). Single path, no captures: renders from files in this repo only (the shared cab is the repo identity IR, a stand-in for a real cab). Rat-style op-amp distortion model (pedal.rat, VERMIN). Starting hypotheses, not a tuned tone.
